name: GroupA+
description: Group A latest LLM meta shadow strategy plus a 00679B defensive bond sleeve.

notes: Used after the first GroupA+ risk-off staged buy is executed.
If 0050 breaks the previous trading day's low, keep deferred buys paused.
If 0050 opens down 1.5% or more, keep deferred buys paused unless the close later confirms recovery.
If 0050 closes above the previous trading day's close, release 50% of the still-deferred buy quantity.
If 0050 or TAIEX recovers intraday without a close confirmation, release 25% of the still-deferred buy quantity.

vix_regime_control.description: Upgrade regime based on VIX levels (FinRL-Meta style). VIX >= risk_off_threshold upgrades risk_on/caution to risk_off. VIX >= severe_threshold upgrades to severe.
notes: VIX is fetched via yfinance. Must be <= actual_data_date.
When VIX >= threshold_severe, risk_on or caution is upgraded to severe.
When VIX >= threshold_risk_off, risk_on is upgraded to risk_off.
These thresholds are NOT used to downgrade any regime.

turbulence_control.description: Calculate Mahalanobis-distance-style turbulence from Group A ticker returns. High turbulence upgrades regime (FinRL-Meta style).
notes: cov_matrix estimated from lookback_window (default 252 trading days).
When turbulence >= threshold_severe, any regime is upgraded to severe.
When turbulence >= threshold_risk_off, risk_on is upgraded to risk_off.
override_regime=true means turbulence can override even risk_off to severe.

recommended_profile.name: minimal_dynamic
recommended_profile.selection_basis: Best GroupA+ final value (-8.52% drag) AND passes promotion gate (drag>-10%, Sharpe delta>-0.05). Live return guard reduces volatility by 2.17% with acceptable return drag.

promotion_gate._comment: Thresholds for deciding whether a GroupA+ variant is promoted to production.
_notes: drag > promotion_max_final_drag_pct means the variant loses LESS than the threshold amount (e.g. -5% means losing up to 5% is acceptable).
sharpe_delta > promotion_min_sharpe_delta means the variant's Sharpe remains within this delta of base.
Return upgrade path (promotion_gate): requires drag > -5% AND sharpe_delta > -0.05
Risk-control path (risk_control_gate): requires volatility_reduction >= 0.01 AND drag > -15% AND sharpe_delta > -0.05
Retrain path: requires volatility_reduction >= 0.02 AND drag > -20%
The -5% drag threshold is calibrated for 2025-2026 market conditions where Group A (with leverage ETFs) is inherently strong.

notes: GroupA+ is not a retrained model; it is a portfolio-level overlay on top of the latest Group A LLM meta shadow signal.
00679B is treated as an external defensive sleeve, not part of the current Group A model action space.
The 10,000-share reference is close to a 20% 00679B sleeve using the 2026-06-05 close.
